title: Perseverance at Falbreen
license: NASA/JPL image-use guidelines; retain the credit line
kind: Observed rover images, stitched mosaic, enhanced color
description: A 360-degree panorama of Falbreen on the rim of Jezero Crater, assembled from 96 rover images. Color bands were enhanced to emphasize differences; the blue sky is a processing effect. Black areas contain no image data.
alt: Rocky Martian terrain, distant hills and rover tracks beneath a blue-toned sky in an enhanced-color Perseverance panorama.
fileInfo: JPEG image data, baseline, precision 8, 4000x975, components 3

title: Two faces of Jupiter
credit: NASA, ESA, STScI, Amy Simon (NASA-GSFC); Image Processing: Joseph DePasquale (STScI)
license: NASA media-use guidelines; retain the full credit line
description: Hubble observations of opposite sides of Jupiter show atmospheric bands, storms, the Great Red Spot and the moon Io. The displayed colors combine separate filtered exposures.
alt: Side-by-side Hubble observations of Jupiter on January 5 and 6, 2024, with orange and cream cloud bands and the Great Red Spot.
fileInfo: JPEG image data, baseline, precision 8, 2000x998, components 3

title: Cosmic Cliffs in Carina
license: NASA media-use guidelines; retain the full credit line
kind: Observed infrared telescope data, assigned-color composite
description: The edge of the star-forming region NGC 3324 in the Carina Nebula. Colors map six near-infrared filters to visible hues; this is observed infrared data, not a visible-light photograph or an artist illustration.
alt: Orange-brown clouds of gas and dust form a jagged ridge below a blue star field in Webb infrared observations of the Carina Nebula.
fileInfo: PNG image data, 2000 x 1158, 8-bit/color RGB, non-interlaced
